scope: Numerical, resource, and reproducibility claims in the camera-ready AI for Chip Design poster

status_vocabulary.reproducible_from_snapshot: The released rows or aggregate snapshot are sufficient to audit the reported value without model calls; this does not imply independent re-scoring of historical candidates.
status_vocabulary.rerunnable_with_external_artifacts: The code path is present, but a clean re-score needs immutable candidate or proof artifacts outside this package.
status_vocabulary.incomplete: At least one provenance, redistribution, producer, or historical-input requirement remains open.
status_vocabulary.stale: A released statement conflicts with newer evidence and must not be used.

claims.claim: The historical training output contains 5,784 unique rows: 5,403 lint and 381 semantic pairs over 1,895 distinct normalized seed identifiers, none of which overlaps the benchmark's 130 distinct seeds. The released file data/rtlrepairdataset_train.jsonl is the 5,775-row repair bucket of the SFT mixture (5,394 lint and 381 semantic pairs, 1,892 distinct seed modules); against Table 3 it lacks 6 rename_declaration and 3 width_mismatch pairs, and every other operator count matches.

external_evidence.release_state: not released; the released training file is data/rtlrepairdataset_train.jsonl

claims.reason: The released file is the SFT mixture's repair bucket, not the historical output: it is in chat format and lacks 9 rows, so the historical SHA-256 cannot be checked against it. Per-sample upstream provenance of MG-Verilog code rests on its dataset-card declaration.

claims.claim: RTLRepairBench contains 459 held-out cases: 374 lint and 85 semantic cases, with the mutation counts shown in the appendix table.
claims.reason: Counts, IDs, buckets, mutation labels, and tracked hashes can be checked directly from the released JSONL files.

claims.claim: For the six-model subset with syntactic recovery from 87.7% to 100.0%, behavioral recovery ranges from 10.6% to 75.3%.
claims.reason: The released aggregate records the six-model subset, both ranges, and all per-model values.

claims.claim: On the 79 cases with definitive formal verdicts in both arms, Tier S over cycles 0--199 gives 60/79 (75.9%) versus 51/79 (64.6%), a -11.4 pp contrast; skipping only cycle 0 gives 72/79 (91.1%) versus 78/79 (98.7%), a +7.6 pp contrast; reset-aware Tier S and Tier F each give 71/79 (89.9%) versus 78/79 (98.7%), a +8.9 pp contrast. Reset-aware Tier S agrees with Tier F on all 158 candidate-arm verdicts in this cohort, but across all 85 cases it clears 12/12 and 27/30 false divergences respectively.
claims.reason: The released aggregate fixes the cohort, all four scoring-contract rows, paired counts, formal coverage, and reset-aware attribution. Re-scoring the historical RTL itself is Level B and needs external retained candidates.

claims.claim: The mined-failure cohort contains 274 cases from 112 source tasks.
claims.reason: Both counts can be recomputed from the released task field.

claims.claim: In the six-model cycle-1 complete-case panel, specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points, with model-specific n from 260 to 274.
claims.reason: The released aggregate contains every displayed n, arm rate, and cycle-1 contrast. Historical candidate re-scoring remains a Level-B operation.

claims.claim: The released artifact supports Level-A reconstruction from frozen rows and aggregates; it does not independently regenerate model outputs or re-score all historical candidates.
claims.reason: Level A is included and checked offline. Levels B and C require retained candidates, proof trees, model weights, or hosted endpoints that are outside this artifact.

claims.claim: Three interleaved temperature-0 draws per model on GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 over a 68-case cohort: no draw has Tier S and Tier F disagreeing in sign, and neither leg of the frozen pair recurs. Moving the comparison off cycle 0 raises the specification contrast in all six draws, +3.1 to +12.3 pp (mean +7.3).

external_evidence.note: six run trees, both arms, 68 cases each; raw model outputs are not released

claims.reason: Generation needs a provider account; scoring needs the pinned prover and Icarus. The scored per-draw summary ships.
